titulo: I don't know, I'll find out: then come back with it
caption:
I don't know, I'll find out: then come back with it

Lena asks if the room is booked until four. Cella doesn't know, so she says so, goes to find out, and comes back with the answer.

For whoever says I don't know, I'll find out.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with a voice on a flat color background in a room with a window. At the top, the words: Lena: booked until 4? For whoever says I don't know, I'll find out. A small doorway-shaped figure with white eyes stands to the left and a second small figure of another color stands to the right, with a white sign between them that says room 4, until ?. The words appear one line at a time: Lena asks, booked until 4? (the second figure asks in a speech bubble). I don't know (the first figure answers in a bubble). I'll find out (it walks off to the left and leaves the frame, the second figure waits with a bubble of dots). Back, until 5 (the first figure walks back in and the sign now says until 5, a star appears and both smile). The closing line: for whoever comes back with the answer. Then: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella didn't know, so she found out. Somebody got the answer.
evolucion: Tres apuestas (junta-ene-s3, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168. (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 17 seguidores no separa causa de ruido: lectura de orden de magnitud. (c) Hora (apuesta 3a): tres Shorts a las 23:00Z contra tres a las 17:00Z; sin el si de N salen todos a las 17:00Z y el campo apuesta_hora de pieza.json dice cual es el brazo.
